title: Nigeria Flood Early Warning input
description: Check flood risk for one or more Nigerian locations (13 communities across Kogi, Benue, Adamawa and Anambra) over the next 7 and/or 30 days.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: REQUIRED. One or more locations to check, each EITHER { "community": "Lokoja", "lga": "Lokoja", "state": "Kogi" } (lga/state are optional fallbacks used if the community name isn't recognised) OR { "latitude": 7.7322, "longitude": 8.5391, "label": "Near Makurdi" } (matched to the nearest covered community within 25km). Coverage is currently 13 communities in Kogi, Benue, Adamawa and Anambra — see the README for the full list. A location outside coverage still returns a valid, explained result rather than an error.

horizons.title: Horizons (days)
horizons.description: Which forecast windows to score: 7, 30, or both. Defaults to both.

includeSources.title: Include sources
includeSources.description: Attach the source references used for each result.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'check' scores the given locations. 'ingest' refreshes outlook, advisory and baseline data first.
